quests.question: He interrupted her, rolled his eyes and laughed at her mistake; that was _____.
quests.explanation: Interrupting, eye-rolling and laughing at someone's mistake are impolite acts, so rude fits.

quests.question: When the group project began, Ravi shared files, listened and took turns; he was _____.
quests.explanation: Sharing files, listening and taking turns are teamwork habits, so cooperative fits; secretive contradicts.

quests.question: She described the spices, bright shawls and shouting traders so _____ that I felt I was there.
quests.explanation: Making a listener feel present needs lively, detailed description, so vividly fits; vaguely contradicts.

quests.question: 'Lovely weather for drowning,' she said with a _____ smile as the downpour began.
quests.explanation: A dry joke about drowning delivered with a twisted smile shows ironic humour, which is wry.

quests.question: Lena took the biggest slice, then a second, and hid the last one; she is so _____.
quests.explanation: Taking the biggest slice, a second, and hiding the last one shows wanting more than a fair share: greedy.

quests.question: After her first gym session, Jo's legs hurt so much she took stairs sideways; she was _____.
quests.explanation: Struggling with stairs after a first workout points to aching muscles, so sore fits.

quests.question: Her critique skipped the fluff and exposed the exact weak point in the plan; it was _____.
quests.explanation: Skipping fluff and pinpointing the exact weakness shows sharp, direct analysis: incisive.

quests.question: Even at the beach, he wore a stiff collar and tie and disliked jokes; he was rather _____.
quests.explanation: A tie at the beach and a dislike of jokes show a serious, conventional person: staid.

quests.question: Her essays always arrive on time and the quality never dips; her work is _____.
quests.explanation: Always on time with no dips in quality shows steady results, so consistent fits; erratic contradicts.

quests.question: Only three people sat in a hall built for five hundred, so it was _____ attended.
quests.explanation: Three people in a hall for five hundred means very few came, so it was sparsely attended.

quests.question: She hadn't read the brief or rehearsed once, so she was clearly _____ for the meeting.
quests.explanation: Not reading the brief or rehearsing means she did no preparation, so ill-prepared fits.

quests.question: The puppy bounced around the garden chasing butterflies all morning; he is so _____.
quests.explanation: Bouncing and chasing butterflies all morning show lots of energy, so lively fits; sluggish contradicts.

quests.question: A blanket, a fire and hot cocoa made the cabin feel warm and _____.
quests.explanation: A blanket, fire and cocoa all create comfort and warmth, so cosy fits; draughty and chilly contradict.

quests.question: Fresh out of college with no job history, Ines felt _____ when asked to manage a team.
quests.explanation: No job history and being new to work mean she lacked practice, so inexperienced fits.

quests.question: The referee treated both teams identically and followed every rule; her decision was _____.
quests.explanation: Treating both teams the same and following the rules is what fair means; biased would be the opposite.

quests.question: The nurse waited calmly while the old man searched his pockets for change; she was very _____.
quests.explanation: Waiting calmly while he searched shows she did not rush him, so patient fits; hasty contradicts.

quests.question: The mango was soft and golden and smelled sweet, so we knew it was _____.
quests.explanation: Softness, golden colour and a sweet smell are signs that a fruit is ready to eat: ripe.

quests.question: This knife opens tins, cuts rope and saws wood; it is a _____ tool.
quests.explanation: Opening tins, cutting rope and sawing wood means many uses, so versatile fits; single-use contradicts.

quests.question: Her handwriting was neat and clear, so every word was perfectly _____.
quests.explanation: Neat, clear handwriting is easy to read, so legible fits; faded, cryptic and smudged would be hard to read.

quests.question: He smiled warmly at clients while quietly altering their invoices; he was _____.
quests.explanation: Smiling warmly while secretly altering invoices means acting one way and doing another: duplicitous.

quests.question: She said exactly what she thought, plainly and without hints; her manner was _____.
quests.explanation: Saying exactly what she thinks, plainly and without hints, is what forthright means.

quests.question: After twenty years of promised reforms that never came, voters grew _____ about politics.
quests.explanation: Twenty years of broken promises wear down enthusiasm, leaving people weary and cynical: jaded.

quests.question: The manager didn't blame others for the missed deadline but admitted it was her call; she is _____.
quests.explanation: Not blaming others and admitting it was her call shows owning the result, which is accountable.

quests.question: The roller coaster spun twice and Maya stumbled off the ride feeling _____.
quests.explanation: Spinning twice and stumbling off point to a swirling head, so dizzy fits; steady contradicts.

quests.question: Our fingers went numb and our breath turned to mist while we waited; it was _____ that day.
quests.explanation: Numb fingers and misty breath show extreme cold, so freezing fits; scorching is the opposite.

quests.question: Caught with the cookie jar open, the boy shuffled his feet and smiled _____.
quests.explanation: Being caught and shuffling his feet show embarrassed guilt, so a sheepish smile fits.

quests.question: The market trader knew every shopper's budget and haggled just right; he was _____.
quests.explanation: Knowing each shopper's budget and haggling just right shows shrewd, street-smart skill: canny.

quests.question: Spotting a hidden fee in a ten-page contract at once, he proved remarkably _____.
quests.explanation: Spotting a hidden fee instantly shows sharp, practical judgment, so astute fits; gullible contradicts.

quests.question: 'Fine, I'll help,' Mo muttered, rolling his eyes and doing the washing-up _____.
quests.explanation: Muttering and eye-rolling show he helped only unwillingly, so grudgingly fits; eagerly contradicts.

quests.question: Nothing went wrong, nobody argued and no one noticed anything unusual; the trip was totally _____.
quests.explanation: No problems, no arguments and nothing unusual describe a trip where little happened: uneventful.
